title: Toddler Sitting with Puppy on Lawn, 1940s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A black and white vintage snapshot capturing a candid moment of a young toddler wearing overalls sitting on a grassy yard beside a small puppy. A stepping stone pathway and lush climbing foliage against a house are visible in the background. The photo features classic deckled scalloped edges typical of the mid-20th century.
